summary: Bridle Trails Family Dentistry, a dental practice in Kirkland, Washington, has notified 20,976 current and former patients about a cybersecurity incident that occurred in the Fall of 2024 that exposed some of their personal and protected health information. According to the April 10, 2026, breach notification letters, an investigation was launched into a potential breach of its email environment, which confirmed that an employee’s email account was accessed by an unauthorized individual between November 19, 2024, and November 25, 2024. The account was reviewed, and Bridle Trails Family Dentistry learned on March 12, 2026, that the account contained a limited amount of personal and health information.
